metadata.description: jevmate: a fast decision layer for coding agents

plugins.name: jevmate
plugins.description: A fast decision layer for coding agents: Jev ranks files, picks tests, sorts failures and reviews diffs, and keeps what the work needs through a compaction, so the expensive model reads only what matters. Measured thresholds.

plugins.name: shelflife-context
plugins.description: Shelflife: durable context for coding agents that knows when it has gone stale. It keeps what you tell the agent and what your decision records say, notices when you change your mind or finish something, flags a recommendation for review when a fact it rested on changes, and reaches agents without hooks through AGENTS.md. Local SQLite, judged by jev on a local model (install jevmate too).
